notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as every other UK National Rail region in this wave.

Single agency (National Rail), single mode (train). No light rail, no metro, no buses. No static GTFS exists for this feed at all — same Darwin-or-nothing gap as West of England and London & South East National Rail.
No doNotGroup needed at any of the three tier-1 stations — Exeter St Davids, Plymouth, Penzance are single-layer, GWR-dominated, platforms distinguished by route not operator.
Boundary through-running station Taunton (TAU) is catalogued flat, NOT a merge point — matches West of England's own Taunton entry from the other side. D2 de-dup concern once both regions ship live.
Night Riviera Sleeper is excluded (out-reservation) at the six stations it calls — see lib/providers/southwest.js.

stops.name: Exeter St Davids
stops.class: hub lock — principal rail terminus for Exeter city; all GWR InterCity and regional services call here. Main interchange between London Paddington services and Southwest corridor. Through-running point for CrossCountry services via Midlands/Bristol.

stops.name: Plymouth
stops.class: hub secondary — Plymouth city station; frequent service to Exeter St Davids (30-60 min), direct service to Penzance via Riviera Line. Served by GWR and CrossCountry. Largest passenger station in region after Exeter.

stops.name: Penzance
stops.class: terminus — westernmost and southernmost station on National Rail network; terminus of Cornish Main Line. GWR regional/InterCity terminus. Night Riviera Sleeper also terminates here but is excluded (out-reservation).

stops.name: Taunton
stops.class: through-running only, boundary to West of England region — not a merge point

stops.name: Newton Abbot
stops.class: through-running only (South West Main Line). GWR and CrossCountry services continue south to Plymouth. No through-running to adjacent regions.

stops.name: Totnes
stops.class: through-running only (Riviera Line branch). GWR regional services continue south to Plymouth. No through-running to adjacent regions.

stops.name: Truro
stops.class: intermediate stop (Cornish Main Line, Truro branch). GWR services call between Exeter and Penzance. No through-running to adjacent regions.

stops.name: St Austell
stops.class: intermediate stop between Truro and Penzance (Cornish Main Line, St Austell branch). No through-running to adjacent regions.

stops.name: St Erth
stops.class: penultimate station before Penzance terminus (Cornish Main Line, St Erth branch). No through-running to adjacent regions.
